name: Main St & 4th Ave Intersection Collision
title: Main St & 4th Ave Intersection Collision
address: Junction of Main St & 4th Ave, Downtown Metro
location: Junction of Main St & 4th Ave, Downtown Metro

summary.executive: At approximately 14:02:11 UTC, Vehicle A (Red Sedan) traveling westbound entered the 4-way signalized intersection at approximately 48 km/h. Concurrently, Vehicle B (Sport Motorcycle) traveling southbound entered the intersection against a transitional yellow/red signal at 36 km/h. Vehicle A applied emergency braking 0.7s prior to impact. The resulting lateral collision occurred in the northwest quadrant of the intersection. Witness statement EV-002 alleging Vehicle A ran a red light was disproven by Dashcam EV-001 ground truth footage.
observations: Vehicle A front dashcam recorded active solid green signal at timestamp 14:02:09.8 (EV-001).
Vehicle A telemetry recorded brake line pressure spike from 0 bar to 85 bar at 14:02:10.5 (EV-003).
Impact registered at 14:02:11.4 with peak lateral acceleration of 6.8G (EV-003).
inferences: Vehicle B motorcycle rider reaction latency estimated at 1.2 seconds with counter-steer initiation (Confidence: 89%).
Vehicle A pre-impact velocity estimated at 48.2 km/h ± 1.5 km/h using video optical flow (Confidence: 94%).

extractedObservations.observation: Vehicle A cruising at steady pace in westbound lane.
Traffic light clearly visible: SOLID GREEN.
Vehicle B (Sport Motorcycle) enters peripheral view from right heading South.

records.transcriptOrExtractedText: I was standing right outside the coffee shop at the corner. The red car was flying down Main Street. I am pretty sure the red car had a red light and just blasted through without even trying to stop.

extractedObservations.observation: Witness claims Vehicle A (Red car) violated red light.
Throttle position at 28%, cruising speed 48.1 km/h.
Brake pedal engaged; brake pressure rose to 85 bar within 150ms.
Deceleration peak -0.82G; yaw rate spike 44 deg/sec.

records.transcriptOrExtractedText: I entered the intersection on a yellow light that had just turned. The other vehicle came out of nowhere at extreme speed.

extractedObservations.observation: Driver B acknowledges entering on late yellow light.

contradictions.topic: Traffic Signal Indication for Vehicle A

claimA.statement: Pedestrian claims Vehicle A blew through a red light at high speed.

claimB.statement: Dashcam Frame #142 shows East-West traffic signal illuminated solid green.

contradictions.systemResolution: Video optical ground truth directly contradicts pedestrian recollection. Discrepancy classified as high-confidence witness memory distortion.

claimA.statement: Pedestrian stated Vehicle A made no attempt to stop.

claimB.statement: OBD-II logged emergency brake activation 0.7s before impact with 85 bar line pressure.

contradictions.systemResolution: Sensor ground truth confirms active emergency braking prior to impact.

summary.executive: Multi-vehicle rear-end sequence on Interstate 101 northbound at mile marker 42.4. Telemetry and rear dashcam recordings confirm Lead Vehicle C executed a sudden emergency stop due to lost cargo. Following Vehicle D maintained compliant 2.2-second following distance and stopped safely. Vehicle E failed to react within safe stopping distance (tailgating at 0.8s gap) causing high-speed secondary collision.
observations: Lead vehicle brake lights activated at 09:15:02.1 (EV-201).
Vehicle D deceleration recorded at -0.74G, coming to full stop with 1.8m safety margin (EV-202).
Vehicle E telemetry confirms zero brake input until 0.3s prior to impact (EV-203).
inferences: Vehicle E driver distracted during critical 1.8s reaction window (Confidence: 92%).
Estimated closing speed of Vehicle E at impact: 64 km/h (Confidence: 89%).
